subject: Post-call recap + POC kickoff proposal — EmberAI evaluation
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Clara Ruiz <clara@emberai.com>, Jason Kim <jason.kim@emberai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, Mar 4, 2027 at 10:12 AM PST
Subject: Post-call recap + POC kickoff proposal — EmberAI evaluation

Hi Clara / EmberAI team — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a proposed kickoff plan so we can lock dates and owners. If anything below is off, flag it and I’ll update the MAP.

Key pain points you shared:
- Inference cost and tail-latency variability when serving batch extraction jobs during daytime windows.
- Lack of deterministic prompts/evals for downstream QA and MRR-affecting edge cases.
- Need for data isolation and audit logs for compliance (SOC 2 scope).

Primary goals for the 6-week POC:
- Reduce per-call 95th percentile latency by 30% for your most frequent pipelines.
- Demonstrate a 2–3x improvement in token cost via batching/cache/quantization without regression on accuracy for the top-20 prompts.
- Establish an eval suite and alerting for quality regressions tied to the prompt set.

Proposed scope / success metrics (first pass):
1) Scope: Serve the 3 high-volume pipelines you described (ingest->normalize->extraction). Redwood will provide a hosted POC environment; EmberAI provides representative prompt sets and a subset of production traffic (sanitized).
2) Metrics: 95p latency, median latency, cost per 1k tokens, extraction F1 on the shared eval set.
3) Prompt/eval plan: We’ll start with your top 20 prompts (please share CSV). We’ll run side-by-side A/B evaluation and produce nightly regression reports.
4) Owners: Redwood: Soojin (SE lead), Ben (infra/ops). EmberAI: Clara (technical lead), Jason (legal / procurement). Marissa will own onboarding and success metrics tracking. Marcus will confirm GPU sizing and quota.
5) Timeline (draft):
   - Week 0 (this week): sign MAP + basic SSO/KMS checklist; exchange sanitized traffic sample.
   - Week 1: environment standing (API keys, VPC peering or private link), initial prompt import and baseline run.
   - Weeks 2–4: iterative optimization (batching, cache, quantization profile), daily syncs twice weekly.
   - Week 5: final eval, performance report, ops playbook for production handoff.

Immediate access/setup asks from Redwood:
- EmberAI point contacts for SSO, infra (VPC peering or PrivateLink engineer), and a sample of the prompt set (CSV)
- Contact for SOC 2 evidence requests (we’ll only need scope-specific artifacts)

Attachments: I’ve attached a mutual_action_plan.xlsx with the draft dates & owners and an MVP prompt CSV template to make the import easier.

Next steps: Clara — can you confirm the proposed kickoff week (we’ve penciled in week of Mar 8) and share the prompt CSV + infra contact? Jason — cc’ing you for any procurement/legal notes.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a shared calendar invite once we confirm.

—
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
From: Clara Ruiz <clara@emberai.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Jason Kim <jason.kim@emberai.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, Mar 4, 2027 at 12:01 PM PST
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + POC kickoff proposal — EmberAI evaluation

Thanks Soojin — helpful summary and aligned on goals. A couple quick notes from our side: 

- Kickoff week: Mar 15 (one week later than your note) works better for our infra team — they have maintenance this week. Can we shift baseline run to Mar 16?
- Prompt CSV: attaching (sanitized_top20_prompts.csv) — includes expected labels for F1 scoring.
- SOC 2: Jason (cc) will accept SOC 2 type II evidence and an engineering contact for any follow-ups. We won’t share production traffic, but we can provide a 48-hour sanitized replay.
- Network: we prefer PrivateLink, but VPC peering is acceptable if PrivateLink isn’t available. Our infra lead is Miguel Ortiz (miguel.ortiz@emberai.com).

We’re good to move forward. I’ll loop in Miguel and Jason on the kickoff invite once dates are locked.

—
Clara Ruiz
Head of Product, EmberAI
clara@emberai.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Clara Ruiz <clara@emberai.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, Mar 4, 2027 at 12:47 PM PST
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + POC kickoff proposal — EmberAI evaluation

Appreciate the clarity, Clara — Mar 16 baseline is fine from our side. A few operational items we’ll own: 

- Marcus will validate GPU pool sizing and confirm whether dedicated capacity is needed for the POC (expectation: 1x A10 / burstable).
- For network: PrivateLink preference noted. We’ll provide an Access Guide (access-instructions.md) and a short checklist for firewall rules.
- Security evidence: we’ll link our SOC 2 summary in the Drive folder for Jason and provide targeted logs (audit log export) for the POC window.

I’ve attached the MVP prompt template (mvp_prompt_suite_v1.csv) and updated the MAP with resource owners. 

Ben
Director, Customer Reliability — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Clara Ruiz <clara@emberai.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, Mar 5, 2027 at 08:09 AM PST
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + POC kickoff proposal — EmberAI evaluation

Looping in some success plan detail from CS side. Proposed eval cadence and ownership: 

- Eval plan: nightly batch eval of the top-20 prompts; weekly regression digest to both teams. Metrics tracked: extraction F1, false-positive rate, latency P50/P95, and per-request cost.
- Alerting: threshold alerts for >5% F1 drop or >40% P95 increase (ops paging to Ben).
- Ownership: Marissa (CS) will manage the eval dashboards and weekly readout; Soojin will own performance tuning; Clara will make final decisions on prompt edits.

Action items I’ll drive before kickoff:
1) Publish the shared Drive folder and upload the MAP and the nightly eval dashboard link.
2) Confirm baseline test harness and seed data (Jason — will coordinate with us for sanitized dataset scope).

Marissa
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Clara Ruiz <clara@emberai.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, Mar 8, 2027 at 09:05 AM PST
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + POC kickoff proposal — EmberAI evaluation

Thanks all — confirmed plan and next actions below. Final checklist before we calendar the kickoff on Mar 16: 

- Clara / Miguel: confirm PrivateLink details or provide VPC peering CIDR by EOD Mar 9. (contact: miguel.ortiz@emberai.com)
- Jason: confirm SOC 2 artifact acceptance and any additional legal redlines for the MAP.
- EmberAI: share the sanitized 48-hour replay and the finalized prompt CSV (we received the top20 but will use the sanitized replay for baseline).
- Redwood: Ben / Marcus to confirm GPU allocation and upload access-instructions.md to Drive by Mar 10.
- Marissa: will publish the nightly eval dashboard and a Slack channel for alerts.

I’ll send a calendar invite for the kickoff (Mar 16, 10:00–11:30 PT) once we get a thumbs-up on the PrivateLink cadence. Looking forward — we’ll aim for a short executive summary on week 4 and a final report at week 5.

Best,
Soojin
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
